category: Polish multi-hoster debrid, prepaid transfer with a registration credit

free_tier.stated: 'Otrzymujesz na start nawet 5 GB' on the home page - up to 5 GB of transfer on registration - and the header offers 'Załóż konto i wypróbuj za darmo'; the FAQ names 1 GB of free transfer, credited after the confirmation link of the registration e-mail is clicked.
free_tier.notes: 'nawet' (up to) means 5 GB is a ceiling on the welcome credit; the FAQ names 1 GB.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: a transfer balance, not a per-file cap

retention.stated: not applicable: a link generator, nothing is stored

egress.terms: 'Nie ma żadnych ukrytych opłat' and 'Nie musisz kupować drogich kont premium'; transfer packs never expire ('Transfer nie wygasa') and the time packs are listed 'Bez limitu prędkości' (no speed limit).
egress.free_allowance: up to 5 GB at registration (1 GB per the FAQ)
egress.price_per_tb: PLN 319.90 per 1000 GB on the 100 GB transfer pack (PLN 31.99 per 100 GB)

interface_detail: Web application: search a file, press download. No API, CLI or protocol endpoint is documented on the reachable pages.
tooling: Browser only as far as the site documents; no download-manager plugin or API is named.
chaining: The 5 GB welcome credit makes it the cheapest way to test whether Polish host coverage matches a user's sources before paying anything, and the per-GB price keeps it out of the base of the stack.

limits.value: prepaid transfer packs that never expire: 2 GB 2,99 zł, 10 GB 6,99 zł, 100 GB 31,99 zł, 400 GB 108,99 zł; time packs: 30 days 'Do 450 GB' 42,99 zł, 360 days 'Do 5400 GB' 273,99 zł

limits_note: More than 57 hosting services are bundled ('57 kont w cenie jednego'). Time packs grant a daily transfer of 15 GB for the purchased period; transfer packs never expire. No per-host daily cap, concurrency limit or fair-use paragraph is published.
binding_note: The balance runs out long before any rate or shaping limit could apply.

identity_cost.detail: The signup panel asks for login, email and password with a terms checkbox, and the login form is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile widget. Registration is free ('Rejestracja i posiadanie konta jest (i zawsze będzie) bezpłatne') and no card is asked at registration; the free transfer is credited after the confirmation link of the registration e-mail is clicked.

reliability_note: The price list differs from Pobierz.biz and RapidTraffic.pl, whose pricing pages return identical content: the time-pack caps differ and the 400 GB transfer pack is priced differently; whether the three brands share one operator is unverified. The cheapest pack on the vendor price list is 2 GB for 2,99 zł, against 'już od 2 zł' on the home page.
confidence_note: The welcome credit, the account count, the package prices and the FAQ are vendor-stated pages read on 2026-11-03 (/pricing, /questions and the home page). debrid.pl corroborates the 100 GB price. Anything behind the login is unverified.
